title.value: Bugs in Large Language Models Generated Code: An Empirical Study
title.justification: The title is derived from the starting phrase of the paper and reflects the focus on bugs in code generated by Large Language Models.
title.quote: Bugs in Large Language Models Generated Code: An Empirical Study

analysis.description: This paper examines the characteristics of bugs found in code generated by Large Language Models (LLMs), specifically CodeGen, PanGu-Coder, and Codex. It identifies 10 distinctive bug patterns and presents them in a taxonomy. The study aims to improve understanding and development of quality assurance techniques for LLM-generated code.

type.justification: The study involves analyzing a sample of buggy code generated by LLMs and conducting a survey with practitioners, indicating its empirical nature.
type.quote: This paper examines a sample of 333 bugs collected from code generated using three leading LLMs...

name.justification: The paper deals with LLMs in the context of code generation, a topic related to automated software engineering.
name.quote: Given the increasing adoption of LLM-based code generation tools... in SE activities, it is critical to understand the characteristics of bugs contained in code generated by LLMs.

name.justification: The study focuses on Large Language Models, which are a part of machine learning.
name.quote: Large Language Models (LLMs) for code have gained significant attention recently.

name.justification: The use of language models indicates a sub-focus on NLP, given they are used to interpret prompts and generate code.
name.quote: Transformer-based models such as Codex... converting natural language descriptions (prompts) into executable programming language statements.

name.justification: Codex is explicitly mentioned as one of the models used to generate code and is analyzed in the study.
name.quote: Transformer-based models such as Codex... trained on large amounts of open-source code repositories, have demonstrated success in producing code.

is_contributed.justification: Codex is used as part of the study but is not contributed by the authors.
is_contributed.quote: This paper examines a sample of 333 bugs collected from code generated using three leading LLMs: CodeGen, PanGu-Coder, and Codex.

is_executed.justification: The paper discusses analyzing code generated by existing LLMs rather than executing these models in experimental settings.
is_executed.quote: This paper examines a sample of 333 bugs collected from code generated using three leading LLMs...

is_compared.justification: The paper compares the bug patterns across different LLMs like CodeGen, PanGu-Coder, and Codex.
is_compared.quote: The third one, Codex, is the model behind Copilot. The code snippets generated by the LLMs... were analyzed in our empirical study.
